title: Keeping Up with the Kernel: Can LLMs Adapt Linux Drivers to Interface Changes?
abstract: arXiv:2611.24269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We analyze collateral evolution in Linux, the coordinated updates that drivers require when the kernel interfaces they depend on change, over the 20 years since it was first studied, covering releases from v3.0 to v7.2. Since v2.6.13, the number of driver files and support libraries has grown about eightfold, a single change to the most widely used library can now reach about 5.3k driver files, and such changes arrive either in bursts or spread over many releases. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that asks models to adapt an old driver module to a target kernel and evaluates the result against the developer's reference patch. The benchmark contains 316 manually confirmed tasks from 202 mainline commits and 268 modules, spanning kernel releases v6.19 to v7.2. translated_title: 紧跟内核步伐：大语言模型能否让 Linux 驱动程序适应接口变更？
translated_abstract: 我们分析了 Linux 中的“伴随演化”现象，即当驱动程序所依赖的内核接口发生变化时，驱动程序所需的协同更新，涵盖自该现象首次被研究以来 20 年间的版本，从 v3.0 到 v7.2。自 v2.6.13 以来，驱动文件和支持库的数量增长了约八倍，对使用最广泛的库的一次修改现在可波及约 5300 个驱动文件，且这类变更要么集中爆发，要么分散在多个版本中。我们提出了 CoEvoBench，这是一个基准测试，要求模型将旧的驱动模块适配到目标内核，并根据开发者的参考补丁来评估结果。该基准包含 316 个经人工确认的任务，来自 202 个主线提交和 268 个模块，跨越内核版本 v6.19 至 v7.2。它区分了 134 个“破坏构建”任务（旧驱动无法编译）和 182 个“构建兼容”任务（旧用法仍可编译）。使用 CoEvoAgent，我们评估了
tldr: 该论文研究了 20 年来 Linux 内核接口变更引发的驱动“伴随演化”现象，并构建了包含 316 个任务的基准 CoEvoBench 来评估大语言模型能否自动将旧驱动适配到新内核。
en_tdlr: This paper studies 20 years of Linux kernel collateral evolution and introduces CoEvoBench, a benchmark of 316 tasks evaluating whether LLMs can automatically adapt old drivers to kernel interface changes.
